question: Two pipes A and B can empty a full tank in 10 minutes and 15 minutes, respectively, whereas pipe C alone can fill the same (empty) tank in 12 minutes. When the tank is full, A and B are opened for 4 minutes and then only pipe A is closed, and C is opened instantly (with B). How much time (in minutes) will it take now to fill the tank completely ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__ 

Please note that 

When A + B are working then they will remove 40 units of water from the tank in 4 minutes. __After that, B and C are working together and we have to find the time required to fill the tank.__

Please note that when we close pipe A and open pipe C at that time, 40 units of the tank are empty.

When B + C work together then they fill -4 + 5 = 1 unit water in 1 minute.

So, to fill 40 units of tank, B + C have to work for 40 minutes.

So 40 is the correct answer.

**__Given:__**

A pipe can empty in 10 minutes

B pipe can empty in 15 minutes

C pipe can fill in 12 minutes
